comment: FundsXML 4 data-quality checks (XQuery 3.1). Each check returns one text per finding; none = passed. The prolog is put in front of every check. Developed and tested against the fundsxml/examples repository.

checks.name: DQ: Control data complete
checks.description: ControlData has UniqueDocumentID, DocumentGenerated, ContentDate and the data supplier's name.

checks.name: DQ: Content date not in the future
checks.description: The ContentDate is not later than today.

checks.name: DQ: ISIN check digits
checks.description: Every ISIN has 12 characters and a correct check digit (ISO 6166).
checks.query:
for $i in //ISIN[not(local:isin-ok(normalize-space(.)))]
return local:at($i, local:where($i) || ': ISIN ' || $i || ' is invalid')

checks.name: DQ: LEI check digits
checks.description: Every LEI has 20 characters and correct check digits (ISO 17442).
checks.query:
for $l in //LEI[not(local:lei-ok(normalize-space(.)))]
return local:at($l, local:where($l) || ': LEI ' || $l || ' is invalid')

checks.name: DQ: Currency codes
checks.description: Currencies and ccy attributes are three capital letters (ISO 4217).

checks.name: DQ: Position weights add up to 100 %
checks.description: The TotalPercentage of all positions of a fund, share class, segment or subfund on a date (over all its own portfolios) add up to 100 % (± 0.5). Share-class portfolios are weighted against the share class, not the fund.

checks.name: DQ: Positions vs. net asset value
checks.description: The market values of all positions of a fund, share class, segment or subfund on a date (in its currency, over all its own portfolios) match its own total net asset value of that date (± 1 %).

checks.name: DQ: No duplicate positions
checks.description: A portfolio lists every position (UniqueID) once.

checks.name: DQ: Positions have master data
checks.description: Every portfolio position's UniqueID has an Asset in AssetMasterData (when the document has AssetMasterData).
checks.query:
let $assets := /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset/UniqueID
where exists($assets)
return for $pos in //Positions/Position[not(UniqueID = $assets)]
       return local:at($pos, 'Position ' || $pos/UniqueID || ' has no Asset in AssetMasterData')

checks.name: DQ: Unused master data
checks.description: Assets in AssetMasterData that no position, transaction or earning refers to.

checks.name: DQ: No negative values of securities
checks.description: Equities, bonds, fund shares, certificates and warrants have no negative market value.

checks.name: DQ: Securities have an identifier
checks.description: Equities, bonds, fund shares, certificates and warrants carry an identifier (ISIN …).
checks.query:
for $pos in //Positions/Position[Equity or Bond or ShareClass or Certificate or Warrant][not(Identifiers/*)]
return local:at($pos, 'Position ' || $pos/UniqueID || ' has no identifier')

checks.name: DQ: Portfolio dates have a net asset value
checks.description: Every portfolio's NavDate has a TotalAssetValue of the node it belongs to (fund, share class, segment, subfund) for that date.
checks.query:
for $p in //Portfolio[NavDate]
let $tavs := $p/../../TotalAssetValues/TotalAssetValue
where exists($tavs) and not($p/NavDate = $tavs/NavDate)
return local:at($p, local:owner($p) || ': no net asset value for the portfolio date ' || $p/NavDate)

checks.name: DQ: Share classes add up to the fund
checks.description: The net asset values of the share classes (in fund currency) add up to the fund's (± 0.5 %) for each date.

checks.name: DQ: Price × shares = share class value
checks.description: NAV price × shares outstanding of a share class matches its net asset value (± 1 %).

checks.name: DQ: Transactions settle after entry
checks.description: A transaction's ValutaDate is not before its EntryDate.

checks.name: DQ: No matured instruments held
checks.description: Positions in bonds, futures, options, swaps, warrants … whose maturity date is before the content date.

snippets.name: FundsXML: All funds
snippets.description: Name, LEI and currency of every fund.

snippets.name: FundsXML: Top 10 positions
snippets.description: The ten largest positions by market value, with name and weight (fund portfolios; share-class portfolios repeat them).
snippets.query:
let $assets := /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset
let $top := (for $p in (//FundDynamicData | //SubfundDynamicData)/Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position
             order by xs:decimal(($p/TotalValue/Amount)[1]) descending
             return $p)[position() le 10]
for $p in $top
return string-join(($p/UniqueID, ($assets[UniqueID = $p/UniqueID]/Name, '')[1], $p/TotalValue/Amount[1] || ' ' || $p/TotalValue/Amount[1]/@ccy, $p/TotalPercentage || ' %'), ' | ')

snippets.name: FundsXML: Exposure by asset type
snippets.description: Sum of market values and weights per AssetType (joined with AssetMasterData) (fund portfolios; share-class portfolios repeat them).
snippets.query:
let $assets := /FundsXML4/AssetMasterData/Asset
for $type in distinct-values($assets/AssetType)
let $ids := $assets[AssetType = $type]/UniqueID
let $pos := (//FundDynamicData | //SubfundDynamicData)/Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position[UniqueID = $ids]
order by sum($pos/TotalPercentage ! xs:decimal(.)) descending
return $type || ': ' || count($pos) || ' positions, ' || sum($pos/TotalPercentage ! xs:decimal(.)) || ' %'

snippets.name: FundsXML: Exposure by currency
snippets.description: Sum of position weights per position currency (fund portfolios; share-class portfolios repeat them).
snippets.query:
let $all := (//FundDynamicData | //SubfundDynamicData)/Portfolios/Portfolio/Positions/Position
for $c in distinct-values($all/Currency)
let $pos := $all[Currency = $c]
order by sum($pos/TotalPercentage ! xs:decimal(.)) descending
return $c || ': ' || sum($pos/TotalPercentage ! xs:decimal(.)) || ' % in ' || count($pos) || ' positions'

snippets.name: FundsXML: Positions over 5 %
snippets.description: Positions whose weight is above 5 % of the portfolio.

snippets.name: FundsXML: Derivative positions
snippets.description: Futures, options, swaps, FX forwards and warrants.
snippets.query: //Positions/Position[Future or Option or Swap or FXForward or Warrant]

snippets.name: FundsXML: Share class prices
snippets.description: NAV price, currency and date of every share class.
